title: Diamond Vault Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: Explains how Business Silver/Gold/Platinum Rewards Cards increase a Diamond Vault account’s APY via additive bonuses of +0.3%, +0.55%, and +0.9% (one card tier at a time). Covers how tier changes update the bonus, the Effective APY formula, and steps to activate/update by associating the card with the same business profile.
